The secret is NOT a placeholder: it is the literal
the integration-test fixtures mint (`rh_turn_` plus 43 base62 characters,
it passes `has_valid_key_shape`. `key_sha256` below is sha256 of exactly
those 51 bytes. It is written down because this example is a demo against
a loopback process holding no provider credentials and spending nothing;
a deployment reachable by anything else mints its own.
No `policy` and no `budget`: this example is about whether the MCP
handshake survives a second gateway, not about routing, so the project is
deliberately unrestricted -- the same admission a deployment with no
control plane at all would produce, minus the anonymity.
